predecessor.observation: The frozen candidate reached 68.75% supported exact-route accuracy and 91.67% natural near-domain unsupported rejection while preserving strong latency gains. Calibration is consumed confirmation evidence and may only define the next problem, never tune v4.

research_question: Can typed multi-view evidence with explicit unknown handling and hierarchical authorized filtering raise natural exact-route accuracy and unsupported-operation rejection simultaneously without sacrificing bounded execution authority or paired latency?

patterns: Aurelio Semantic Router: route-local thresholds and pre-selection route filters
RouteLLM: separate scalar evidence estimation from deterministic threshold application
LlamaIndex: retrieve a bounded candidate subset before final selection
Haystack ConditionalRouter: explicit no-route behavior when no deterministic rule matches
LiteLLM: structured capability boundaries and boundary-specific routing thresholds
vLLM Semantic Router: separate signal families, true/false/unknown state, score-kind-aware comparison, explicit on-unknown policy
LangGraph: routing chooses among predeclared graph destinations rather than creating topology

architecture_principles: The registered schema graph remains the only source of executable routing authority.
Caller, policy, health, and explicit schema constraints reduce the authorized candidate set before semantic evidence is evaluated.
Tool-domain, operation-action, field/concept, qualifier, and negative-capability evidence are distinct signal kinds.
Unavailable or failed evidence is unknown, never numeric zero.
Raw scores from incompatible score kinds are never averaged or directly compared.
Semantic evidence may rank or veto existing routes but may not create a tool, endpoint, field, argument, credential, or side effect.
A positive route requires graph consistency plus calibrated evidence; unresolved conflict abstains.
Safe abstention is preferred to an executable false route.
planned_ablations: frozen 0.10 graph candidate as historical baseline only
typed evidence contract without routing behavior change
negative capability evidence on fresh unsupported development families
selective pairwise reranking for unresolved authorized siblings
promotion_sequence: generate and audit fresh v4 development corpus
run paired baselines and ablations on development only
freeze one candidate only if every development gate passes
generate fresh v4 calibration after freeze
close cycle without tuning if calibration fails
generate v4 blind only if calibration passes
